title: ArrowUtil
description: A client-side utility mod that adds quality-of-life features for bows - like trails, shots indicator, and much more!
body:
# ArrowUtil
A client-side utility mod that adds quality-of-life features for bow and crossbow users.

## Features
- **Arrow Trails**
Colored trails follow arrows in flight. Your arrows are green, allies are blue, enemies are red. Trails can linger after the arrow stops or is picked up.

- **Path Prediction**
See where your arrow will land while aiming. A dotted arc shows the predicted trajectory with impact point highlighting.
  
- **Aiming Stats**
Displays your current aim angle and bow charge near the crosshair. Can show as numbers or progress bars.

- **Last Shot Ghost**
A transparent figure appears where you last shot, showing your stance, angle, and power. Useful for practicing consistent shots.

- **Last Shot Helper**
Guides you to replicate your previous shot. Shows direction indicators and angle differences while aiming, plus a ghost trajectory of your last shot.

- **You Hit It!**
Brief notification when your arrow hits a target, showing the distance (and optionally damage dealt).

- **Arrow Recovery**
Highlights recoverable arrows stuck in blocks within range. Filter to show only your own arrows.

- **Configuration**
All features can be enabled/disabled and customized. Access settings via [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) or the `/arrowutil` command.

Requires [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) for the configuration screen.
